description: Creates a Stripe Checkout URL that upgrades this token's owner to Hobby ($3/mo) or Pro ($15/mo). Call it when the user asks to upgrade, or right after a tool error that has upgrade_url / user_message (a plan limit). Show the returned checkout_url (or user_message) to the user: a human opens it and pays; never open or pay it yourself. When payment completes the same token gets the higher limits automatically. Inputs: plan (hobby or pro; omitted means the next plan up), token, optional how_heard (at most 200 characters, stored on the owner), and optional upgrade_trigger (the limit field from the error, custom_domain_limit, or manual). A token already on a paid plan gets portal_url instead. The call itself does not charge.

how_heard.description: Optional note, at most 200 characters. Stored on the owner.

plan.description: Plan to buy. Omit for the next plan above the current one (Free -> hobby, Hobby -> pro).

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

upgrade_trigger.description: The limit field of the plan-limit error that sent you here (for example publish_rate or quota_sites), custom_domain_limit, or manual.

name: get_upgrade_link
title: Get a paid-plan checkout link
